Version \textbf{1.0(d)}.
Open  \href{https://rubinobs.atlassian.net/projects/LVV?selectedItem=com.atlassian.plugins.atlassian-connect-plugin:com.kanoah.test-manager__main-project-page\#!/v2/testCase/LVV-E3888}{\textit{ LVV-E3888 } }

Verify that the single-visit 5-sigma (i.e., S/N = 5) depth for
unresolved point sources in each of 6 LSST filters meets the
specification, assuming the reference conditions specified in
LSR-REQ-0089 scaled appropriately for each filter.

None
